lyrics.ja: 誰かに届けこの思い
lyrics.romaji: Dareka ni Todoke Kono Omoi
lyrics.en: Let this feeling reach someone
lyrics.zh: 願這份心意能傳達給某人

lyrics.ja: いつでも強くありたいと
lyrics.romaji: Itsu demo Tsuyoku Aritai to
lyrics.en: I want to always be strong

lyrics.ja: いつでも弱い自分から
lyrics.romaji: Itsu demo Yowai Jibun kara
lyrics.en: From my always-weak self
lyrics.zh: 從那個總是軟弱的自己

lyrics.ja: 目をそらさないように
lyrics.romaji: Me wo Sorasanai You ni
lyrics.en: So as not to look away

lyrics.ja: 誰かに響けこの気持ち
lyrics.romaji: Dareka ni Hibike Kono Kimochi
lyrics.en: Let this feeling resound in someone
lyrics.zh: 願這份心情能在某人心裡迴響

lyrics.ja: いつでも優しくありたいと
lyrics.romaji: Itsu demo Yasashiku Aritai to
lyrics.en: I want to always be kind

lyrics.ja: いつでも寂しい自分に
lyrics.romaji: Itsu demo Sabishii Jibun ni
lyrics.en: From my always-lonely self
lyrics.zh: 從那個總是寂寞的自己

lyrics.ja: そっと目をそらしていた
lyrics.romaji: Sotto Me wo Sorashite Ita
lyrics.en: I had quietly been averting my eyes

lyrics.ja: 見慣れた曇り空
lyrics.romaji: Minareta Kumori Zora
lyrics.en: The familiar cloudy sky

lyrics.ja: 光刺しますように
lyrics.romaji: Hikari Sashimasu You ni
lyrics.en: May the light pierce through

lyrics.ja: きっと空は海より深いから
lyrics.romaji: Kitto Sora ha Umi yori Fukai kara
lyrics.en: Surely because the sky is deeper than the sea
lyrics.zh: 天空一定比海還要深邃

lyrics.ja: 天気予報はあてにならないと
lyrics.romaji: Tenki Yohou ha Ate ni Naranai to
lyrics.en: Saying the weather forecast can't be trusted

lyrics.ja: 自分で選んだ雲を並べながら
lyrics.romaji: Jibun de Eranda Kumo wo Narabe Nagara
lyrics.en: While arranging the clouds I chose myself
lyrics.zh: 排列著自己選擇的雲朵

lyrics.ja: これでいいよと頷く
lyrics.romaji: Kore de Ii yo to Unazuku
lyrics.en: I nod and say, "This is fine"

lyrics.ja: 今日も海より深い空の下
lyrics.romaji: Kyou mo Umi yori Fukai Sora no Shita
lyrics.en: Today too, under a sky deeper than the sea
lyrics.zh: 今天也在比海更深的天空下

lyrics.ja: 皆の晴れた笑顔を夢見て
lyrics.romaji: Minna no Hareta Egao wo Yumemite
lyrics.en: Dreaming of everyone's sunny smiles
lyrics.zh: 夢想著大家晴朗的笑容

lyrics.ja: 伝えたい言葉を紡ぎだしながら
lyrics.romaji: Tsutaetai Kotoba wo Tsumugidashi Nagara
lyrics.en: While spinning out the words I want to convey

lyrics.ja: これでいいよと歌い続ける
lyrics.romaji: Kore de Ii yo to Utaitsuzukeru
lyrics.en: I keep singing, "This is fine"

lyrics.ja: 誰にも届かないのかも
lyrics.romaji: Dare ni mo Todokanai Kamo
lyrics.en: It may not reach anyone
lyrics.zh: 或許無法傳達給任何人

lyrics.ja: 何度もくじけそうになる
lyrics.romaji: Nando mo Kujikesou ni Naru
lyrics.en: I feel like giving up many times
lyrics.zh: 好幾次都快要挫折放棄

lyrics.ja: 誰かに見つけてほしくて

lyrics.ja: そっと手を伸ばしてみた
